review_scope: Only the two 2-of-3 clear-bad rows from the already locked targeted60 consensus; native images checked at original pixels against the same-class review cohort.

policy.retain: An obvious model-relative blur, fusion, gross topology, or major limb/object attachment failure is visible without relying on class rarity or minor detail.
policy.downgrade: The majority call is explainable by ordinary model quality, plausible pose/occlusion/perspective, semantic mismatch without a visible structural artifact, or only mild ambiguity.

rows.reason: 前轮出现清楚的重复/脱离椭圆轮圈，轮叉与轮圈拓扑不能连续追踪；这不是透视缩短或普通线缆复杂度，明显低于同类双人自行车的通常结构质量。
球员左侧伸出细长、近乎刚性的异常附着物并以圆盘状末端结束，手臂、手套/球棒与躯干的连接无法形成合理运动关系；主体虽清晰，但该主要物体/肢体错位足够明显。
